description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'BaseOpenmrsDatatype' that serves as a superclass for custom datatypes for OpenmrsObjects within the OpenMRS project. It extends 'SerializingCustomDatatype' and provides a serialize method returning the UUID of the object.

classes.name: BaseOpenmrsDatatype
classes.description: An abstract class for custom datatypes involving OpenmrsObjects, providing serialization based on UUID.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an OpenmrsObject to its UUID, or null if the object is null.
